name: Wotan's Retribution

automation.text: You teleport directly behind the creature that triggered this Reaction and make a melee attack against it with a weapon you are wielding. You have Advantage on your attack roll. On a hit, the creature takes the damage from your attack as well as an amount of damage equal to the damage it dealt to you when it triggered this Reaction.

subclasses: Hand of Dread Pugilist, Occultist Monster Hunter, Sanguine Thief Rogue, Spellslinger Gunslinger, Arcane Hand Monk, Arcane Hand Monk
casttime: Reaction, which you take when a creature scores a Critical Hit against you
